title: ci: wire impact ranking, runner map storage, and replay benchmark into post-merge.yml

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## Goal
Connect the coverage map, failure history, and fail-fast batch ordering to the self-hosted post-merge runner, and measure the replay speedup.

## Scope
- Store `coverage.json.gz` and `failures.jsonl` outside the git checkout on the `camcraft-post-merge` runner under `$RUNNER_WORKSPACE/.camcraft-impact/` (same pattern as `.github/workflows/pr-test.yml`).
- Update `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml` to pass `--rank-from` (previous green SHA), `--impact-map`, and `--failure-history` into `cargo xtask gate batch`.
- Append each finished gate result to `failures.jsonl`.
- Refresh `coverage.json.gz` after a green run only when the map is stale (older than 24 hours or 20 or more commits behind), using `llvm-tools` on the runner.
- Upload `coverage.json.gz` and `failures.jsonl` as a rolling workflow artifact (`impact-map-main`, 14-day retention) so local reviewers can download them for `cargo xtask impact`.
- Document the `llvm-tools` requirement in `.claude/skills/runners/SKILL.md`.
- Note: `.github/workflows/` edits require maintainer review (`needs-maintainer`) and add no `schedule` or `pull_request` trigger.
- Run an empirical replay on the 16-core runner against PR #2664 (`#2713`), PR #2273 (`#2317`), and PR #2182 (`#2306`), and record time-to-first-failure and coverage-refresh cost in the PR body.

## Done means
`post-merge.yml` runs ranked batch gates with runner-local map and history storage, uploads `impact-map-main` on refresh, and the PR body reports measured full coverage time, compressed map size, and time-to-first-failure before and after ranking for PRs #2664, #2273, and #2182.

Part of #2738
